name: Fundación Acrescere: support for foster care (Apoyo al Acogimiento Familiar)
coverage: Madrid and Valencia (foster care awareness programmes)
notes: Found through a company database search (Clay), then read on its own website. Runs a programme to promote foster care (fomento del acogimiento familiar) and raise the number of families who offer, with talks in schools and parent groups, and meeting spaces for foster families. It also promotes foster care for unaccompanied migrant children. It does not say that it assesses or approves carers. No enquiry form was seen; the forms on the pages read are for donations.

name: Asociación de Voluntarios de Acogimiento Familiar (AVAF)
notes: Found through a company database search (Clay), then read on its own website. A non-profit association, founded in 1988, that promotes foster care and supports foster families. People interested in fostering are invited to call its free information line. Its programmes include foster care promotion in Elche (Elche Acogedor). The form on the site is for membership. It does not say that it assesses or approves carers.

name: ACOUGO (Asociación Galega de Familias de Acollida)
coverage: Galicia (association of foster families; office in Santiago de Compostela)
notes: Found through a company database search (Clay), then read on its own website. An association of foster families. It offers information, advice and help with procedures to people thinking about fostering (acollemento familiar), and support groups for foster families. It does not approve carers. The contact form is general and asks for name, postcode, phone, email and a message.
